rows.capability: All 26 explicitly registered launch flags; help/version/info and completion
rows.difference: F05 implements local inspection, policy, presentation, initial views, periodic table repaint and invocation connection overrides. All audited flags are recognized; splash remains explicitly unavailable; inversion is delivered under U01 and O06 adds --screen-dump-dir for reviewed local exports. Shell completion remains D13. Q15 adds a local redacted bug-report bundle, recoverable resource-view errors and private post-restoration crash reports.
rows.public_summary: Launch flags provide help, version, local diagnostics, read-only policy, presentation controls, session color inversion, startup views and connection overrides. Version 0.4 adds an export-directory option and local artifact browser startup. Splash and shell completion are unavailable. Create redacted diagnostic bundles and retry recoverable resource-view errors.

rows.capability: Context/kubeconfig/cluster/user/namespace selection and connection overrides
rows.difference: C01/F05/C08 implement catalogue merging, scoped clients, alternate cluster/user and invocation overrides, with captured directory, credential and proxy transport. Owned HTTP/TLS and Kubernetes prove API and private delegated identity; complete real-provider certification is not inferred.
rows.public_summary: Select kubeconfig files, context, namespace, connection overrides, and user settings explicitly. Each context uses its own connection and passes that identity to delegated tools.

rows.capability: AWS EKS, Azure AKS, GKE and generic exec/OIDC/cert/token credentials
rows.difference: C06/C07/C08 deliver owned AWS/Azure/GKE/OIDC-shaped exec contracts, token-file and TLS certificate renewal, captured identity and generic explicit native login. Actual cloud/issuer certification remains opt-in Q05 #87. Legacy auth-provider/basic entries are intentionally rejected with migration; no complete real-cloud compatibility claim.
rows.public_summary: Exec bearer/certificate helpers, token files and explicit native helper login are available. Local provider-shaped tests do not certify real cloud accounts or identity providers. Legacy auth-provider/basic entries require migration.

rows.capability: TLS/CA/client certificates, proxy, request timeout and impersonation
rows.difference: C01/F05/C08 qualify CA/client certificates, TLS names, request bounds, token-file/exec renewal, captured HTTP(S)/SOCKS5 proxies and repeated impersonation. Actual HTTP CONNECT kind logs/exec/forwards retain connection identity. SOCKS5/SPDY limits are documented; O04 #71 adds current-identity reviews and native RBAC evidence with explicit partial/unknown status.
rows.public_summary: CA and client certificates, TLS names, timeouts, proxy settings and repeated impersonation are supported. Version 0.4 adds current-identity permission reviews and observed RBAC browsing; SOCKS5 streaming limits remain explicit.

rows.capability: Context rename/delete and persisted per-context view/namespace preferences
rows.difference: C01 ordinary context/scope switching never rewrites kubeconfig. M08 #63 adds explicit rename/delete of one owning file with review, typed delete confirmation, a 0600 backup, digest recheck and atomic replace; ambiguous ownership is refused and shared clusters/users are kept. Persisted per-context view preferences remain planned.
rows.public_summary: Selecting a context leaves kubeconfig unchanged. Renaming or deleting a context uses explicit review and a backup. Local per-context display preferences can be saved.

rows.capability: API discovery, resource aliases and dynamic/CRD server columns
rows.difference: C05/B06 provide discovery-qualified aliases and explicit versions, live generic tables with typed server columns or metadata fallback, bounded session-local column selection, captured YAML/details, scope/history routing and owned discovery/removal refresh. Generic mutations, persistent custom preferences/hotkeys and reactive jump chains retain M05/U02/U06; full parity is not claimed. O03 #70 follows actual discovered owner GVKs in native development-source graphs; it does not infer arbitrary custom-resource reference fields. Complete issue/current-head qualification remains pending. Development source adds descriptor-bound read-only summaries for 18 additional families and a separate Events view; unknown versions retain metadata fallback.
rows.public_summary: Discovery and generic browsing remain available. Version 0.4 adds 18 curated read-only families and an identity-safe Events workspace.

rows.capability: Live resource updates, manual refresh, retry/reconnect and errors
rows.difference: B02 adds actual incremental pod rows and stale/error retention to the C03/C04 backend, including quiet renewal correction #107. Manual refresh and wider resource integration remain planned; no full CORE02 parity claim.
rows.public_summary: Live lists and watches keep a last snapshot during temporary failures and reconnect or relist as needed. Refresh renews discovery and the selected resource stream. A stale snapshot does not establish current server state.

rows.capability: Resource command mode, aliases, autocomplete, namespace/context arguments
rows.difference: B03 implements available pod aliases, shared initial/interactive scope commands and local bounded Tab/arrow suggestions (#115). Preview #125 adds a real namespace workspace table and resource-aware command/history routing. Other resource tables, CRD/custom aliases and broader command routing remain their owning tickets. Focused #127 adds inline command suggestions without an overlay and stable shared frame/header geometry with mouse/resize checks. Focused #129 adds a bordered command bar and local context workspace table with retained filtering/history; captured container rows expose name-matched status/specification columns without claiming live usage. U02 #57 implements bounded per-owner navigation keys, literal aliases and explicit version-pinned column width/alignment/order/visibility and typed-sort saves. Server schemas invalidate stale layouts. This source checkpoint does not claim broader navigation/filter/jump/plugin parity. B07 #61: Next-release source adds shared nested command bars in captured resource/container/log workspaces. Invalid/read-only commands retain streams; accepted scope changes drain covered owners before replacing clients. Resource actions preserve the originating UID. Completion remains inline and local; embedded-shell keys retain remote ownership.
rows.public_summary: Nested resource, container, and log views share inline command bars. Invalid commands keep the current view; scope changes close old reads before switching. Actions keep the selected resource identity.

rows.capability: Regex/inverse/fuzzy filtering, label/field selectors and filter history
rows.difference: B03 implements local case-insensitive literal text and Unicode VERSION1 regex filters with a total timeout, explicit errors and current snapshot/query guards. Inverse/fuzzy matching, selectors and saved filter history remain B07. B07 #61: Next-release source adds inverse Unicode regex, case-insensitive fuzzy subsequences, bounded local label/allowlisted field filters and memory-only command/filter entry recall. Regex keeps its 50-ms total budget; metadata filters use a separate 250-ms budget and one-snapshot cache. Server-side selector parity and persistent filter history are not claimed.
rows.public_summary: Local filters support literal text, regular expressions, inverse regex, fuzzy subsequences, and supported label/field terms. Queries have size and time limits. Command and filter recall lasts for this session.

rows.capability: Breadcrumbs, back/forward/last-command navigation, namespace favorites
rows.difference: B03 implements bounded scope/filter/viewport history. Preview #125 retains pod/namespace resource kind and displays nested namespace/pod/container/log routes with the current Escape destination. Broader resource drill-down remains planned. Focused #129 adds a bordered command bar and local context workspace table with retained filtering/history; captured container rows expose name-matched status/specification columns without claiming live usage. B07 #61: Next-release source adds bounded command recall with draft restoration, policy-rechecked last-command repeat and explicitly saved per-context namespace favorites. Scope/view history remains separately bounded and memory-only; favorites do not grant namespace-list permissions or create API rows.
rows.public_summary: Commands and filters have separate histories with unfinished-draft restoration. Repeating a command uses its normal checks. Namespace favorites can be saved per context; view history stays memory-only.

rows.capability: Keyboard/mouse, horizontal/vertical scrolling, paging, resize and Unicode
rows.difference: B02 qualifies live row navigation, paging, horizontal scrolling, Unicode, responsive 40×12 layouts and UID/scroll retention under updates. Broader B07 interaction and platform qualification remain separate from Q02 local transport evidence. Focused #127 adds inline command suggestions without an overlay and stable shared frame/header geometry with mouse/resize checks. Focused #129 adds a bordered command bar and local context workspace table with retained filtering/history; captured container rows expose name-matched status/specification columns without claiming live usage. Q02 #33 adds actual Linux SSH/tmux/SSH-to-tmux workspace/log/shell resize, Unicode, focus and standard-color checks, with fresh-wheel trials. Wider B07 interaction and actual macOS/emulator qualification remain open. B07 #61: Next-release source adds independent configurable read-only text/help navigation, explicit mouse opt-in, owned remote clipboard transport trials and live container watch updates preserving selected name/viewport. Fatal permission/scope/UID invalidation is sticky, drains covered work and rejects late worker results. Physical emulator certification remains separate.
rows.public_summary: Text/help and log navigation have independent key profiles. Mouse reporting requires opt-in. Container state refreshes from the pod watch while preserving selection. Clipboard behavior depends on the outer terminal.

rows.capability: Typed sorting, movable/custom/wide columns, errors-only and selection ranges
rows.difference: B02/B05/B06 provide typed sorting, stable UID selection and generic server-column choice/order including optional wide-priority fields, bounded to this session. Persistent/movable views, errors-only filters and selection ranges remain B07/U02. U02 #57 implements bounded per-owner navigation keys, literal aliases and explicit version-pinned column width/alignment/order/visibility and typed-sort saves. Server schemas invalidate stale layouts. This source checkpoint does not claim broader navigation/filter/jump/plugin parity. B07 #61: Next-release source adds transient wide columns (Pod Node/IP/QoS), observable-errors filtering with an explicit unknown count, bounded UID marks/ranges in filtered/sorted order and marked-row batch review. Existing typed sorting, configuration saves, read-only/default-Cancel/UID guards remain enforced. Health interpretation is a deliberate known-condition subset.
rows.public_summary: Wide mode adds available columns. Error filtering distinguishes known failures from unknown health. Up to 100 resource UIDs can be marked for a separate batch review.

rows.capability: Help, key hints, header/logo/breadcrumb visibility, fullscreen and quit behavior
rows.difference: Implemented pod, namespace, container and log shortcuts appear in the shared responsive header (#125); help retains secondary keys in short terminals. Per-view custom hotkeys and other resource actions remain planned. Focused #127 adds inline command suggestions without an overlay and stable shared frame/header geometry with mouse/resize checks. Preview #132 refines the responsive header brand to an original ktrol ASCII logo; project/CLI naming and presentation controls are retained. B07 #61: Next-release source extends shared header/frame chrome to read-only inspection/help and provides session header/trail/fullscreen toggles without persisting preferences. Per-view navigation keys and nested command/search Escape destinations retain focused-input ownership.
rows.public_summary: Inspection and help share the workspace frame. Session controls hide headers, trails, or frame borders without saving preferences. Escape and navigation depend on the focused view.

rows.capability: YAML/describe/details, managedFields toggle, text search and auto-refresh
rows.difference: B04 delivers captured-UID pod YAML/details/events, managedFields visibility and literal text search. Automatic viewer refresh remains U06.
rows.public_summary: Selected resources provide details, redacted YAML, and related events with local search. Inspection is a read snapshot; reopen it to refresh.

rows.capability: Copy resource/namespace/text with native clipboard and OSC52 over SSH/tmux
rows.difference: B04 and S02 copy redacted inspection/log text using Textual OSC52. Q02 #33 exercises redacted log-copy controls over SSH/tmux, without certifying the physical host clipboard. B07 #61 adds bounded native plaintext via macOS AppKit/system osascript or foreground-owned X11 xclip and bounded base64 OSC52 with tmux framing. Q19 #220 adds foreground-owned wl-copy with an explicit UTF-8 plaintext MIME type, local Wayland-before-X11 selection and actionable terminal fallback. Explicit name/namespace/table-text controls preserve existing redacted views. Native/headless 1-MiB and terminal 64-KiB UTF-8 limits refuse rather than truncate. Wayland invocation and process ownership use real fake-executable contracts; real Wayland compositor receipt is not certified. Owned Xvfb/ephemeral hosted macOS roundtrips and outer PTY receipts do not claim every physical-terminal paste acknowledgement.
rows.public_summary: Explicit copy uses local macOS native text, Wayland wl-copy, X Window System xclip, or terminal OSC52 with tmux framing. Wayland takes precedence locally; automatic SSH mode selects OSC52. Native text accepts up to 1 MiB and terminal copy 64 KiB. Text stays on stdin for native helpers. A sent request does not prove a compositor or outer terminal accepted it.

rows.capability: Save resources/logs, screen-dump browser and export path settings
rows.difference: O06 #73 integrates frozen resource/document/log/diagnostic/table exports, inspectable support JSON, private reviewed filesystem operations, separate one-use sensitive/overwrite consent and an offline saved-artifact browser. The --screen-dump-dir override selects the session export root. Focused deterministic codecs, service/adapter behavior, actual Root UI flows and offline/path contracts are verified; exact-source whole-package/platform qualification remains required.
rows.public_summary: Version 0.4 adds reviewed redacted resource, log, diagnostic, screen and support exports, an explicit directory option and a local saved-artifact browser. Sensitive resource YAML and overwrite/deletion need separate confirmation.

rows.capability: About/branding and optional update notification
rows.difference: U01 implements explicit built-in/custom theme preview and global/context persistence, runtime inversion with contrast repair, original About and a real optional bounded/cached/offline-safe stable release check. Reactive reload, transparent colors and icon preferences remain U06; full skin parity is not claimed.
rows.public_summary: About shows the installed version and license. Stable-release notices are opt-in and can use a cached result; they never install an update.

rows.capability: Pods/containers including init and ephemeral containers, events and namespaces
rows.difference: Live UID-based pod tables and captured regular/init container navigation are implemented. Preview #125 adds the real Namespace LIST/WATCH table with lifecycle/age, filtering, all-scope action and Enter/Escape restoration. B05 adds the standard resource tables. Live container status and ephemeral containers remain #61 and #78. Focused #129 adds a bordered command bar and local context workspace table with retained filtering/history; captured container rows expose name-matched status/specification columns without claiming live usage. O09 #232 adds raw Event objects and separate reason/object occurrence groups, warning filtering, bounded details and UID-guarded navigation; it does not add Event mutations or infer incident duration.
rows.public_summary: Browse live Pods, containers and namespaces. Version 0.4 adds Events warning filtering, occurrence groups and individual member inspection.

rows.capability: Deployments, StatefulSets, DaemonSets, ReplicaSets, replication controllers, workloads
rows.difference: B05 provides typed workload tables and M03 apps workload operations; generic ReplicationController browsing is delivered. O03 #70 adds UID-checked owner chains, separate inferred selector matches and zero-replica template declarations in development source. Complete issue/current-head qualification remains pending.
rows.public_summary: Standard workload tables support reviewed scaling, restart and explicit revision rollback. Version 0.4 adds native controller and Pod relationships; selector matches remain separate from ownership.

rows.capability: Services, Endpoints, EndpointSlices, Ingresses and NetworkPolicies
rows.difference: B05/B06 provide networking resource browsing. O03 #70 adds separately labelled Service selector membership, discovered EndpointSlice associations, available legacy Endpoints fallback and backend targetRef identity/readiness/ports in development source. Denied and incomplete endpoint sources remain explicit; broader networking diagnostics remain separate. O09 #232 adds descriptor-bound read-only EndpointSlice, NetworkPolicy and IngressClass columns, details and guarded links in development source.
rows.public_summary: Service and Ingress tables are available. Version 0.4 adds curated EndpointSlice, NetworkPolicy and IngressClass tables and reported service backends with separate selector matches, preserving unknown endpoint identity and incomplete reads.

rows.capability: Nodes, PV/PVC, StorageClasses, priority/scheduling, HPA/PDB/quota/limits
rows.difference: B05 implements Nodes, PVs, PVCs and StorageClasses with typed capacities, scope and inspection. O09 #232 adds read-only HPA, VPA, PDB, PriorityClass, RuntimeClass, ResourceQuota and LimitRange summaries, details and guarded links in development source; broader scheduling diagnostics and enforcement remain separate. O01 #68 adds current Node usage/allocatable percentages and generic extended-resource capacity with incomplete Pod-allocation status when cluster-wide Pod reads are unavailable. O03 #70 adds declared Pod/node placement and explicit PV/PVC/PriorityClass reference relationships in development source; scheduling constraints are not placement and unknown implicit PV Secret namespaces stay incomplete.
rows.public_summary: Node, PV, PVC and StorageClass tables are available. Version 0.4 adds curated HPA/VPA, PDB, scheduling-class, quota and limit tables, Node CPU/memory usage, allocatable percentages and vendor-neutral extended-resource capacity. The cluster overview adds known pressure/unscheduled states; broader quota/disruption diagnostics remain planned. Relationships distinguish declared placement, PV/PVC bindings and static PriorityClass references.

rows.capability: ConfigMaps, Secrets, service accounts and RBAC resource families
rows.difference: M05 adds explicit ConfigMap/Secret key metadata, reveal/copy and UTF-8/Base64 controls with fresh UID/version-bound reads, plus common guarded Secret editing. Environment provenance remains O07; full family parity is not claimed. O04 #71 adds native role/binding/subject evidence and current-identity permission reviews. O03 #70 adds supported static ConfigMap/Secret/ServiceAccount UsedBy declarations without values or proof of process consumption; scoped acceptance is recorded in the relationship delivery. O09 #232 adds allowlisted ServiceAccount and four RBAC resource tables/details, reusing authorization evidence rather than duplicating role matching or adding RBAC writes.
rows.public_summary: ConfigMap/Secret payload views remain deliberate. Version 0.4 adds read-only ServiceAccount and RBAC summaries with declared links and authorization evidence.

rows.capability: Custom resources, unknown APIs and custom columns/jump chains
rows.difference: C05/B06 provide discovery-qualified aliases and explicit versions, live generic tables with typed server columns or metadata fallback, bounded session-local column selection, captured YAML/details, scope/history routing and owned discovery/removal refresh. Generic mutations, persistent custom preferences/hotkeys and reactive jump chains retain M05/U02/U06; full parity is not claimed. U02 #57 implements bounded per-owner navigation keys, literal aliases and explicit version-pinned column width/alignment/order/visibility and typed-sort saves. Server schemas invalidate stale layouts. This source checkpoint does not claim broader navigation/filter/jump/plugin parity. U06 #64 adds configured jumps between discovered resources, including explicit non-preferred versions. O03 #70 follows actual discovered owner GVKs in native development-source graphs; it does not infer arbitrary custom-resource reference fields. Complete issue/current-head qualification remains pending.
rows.public_summary: Discovered APIs provide served-version selection, typed printer columns, inspection and saved schema-pinned layouts. Version 0.4 follows discovered owners in native graphs; configured jumps share navigation history. Generic mutation and arbitrary custom-resource reference scanning remain unavailable.

rows.capability: Current/previous logs, container selection and all-container/workload logs
rows.difference: Captured-UID current/previous regular/init/ephemeral logs plus all-container/workload output. Exact same-namespace controller chains determine membership; eight concurrent readers, 256 current sources, 64 recent removed statuses, per-source and aggregate retention bounds. Explicit source admission/filtering, sanitized plain/JSON export, container-start enrollment and drained ownership; no automatic replay or synchronized-clock ordering.
rows.public_summary: Read current or previous container output and aggregate supported workload logs. Readers follow controller membership and identify each source independently.

rows.capability: Head/tail/time windows, timestamps, wrap, follow/pause and column lock
rows.difference: S02 implements head 1000, tail 100/1000/all, relative or RFC3339 time windows, timestamps, wrapping, separate reception pause/viewport follow and column lock. Retained output is bounded; the API may rotate older output.
rows.public_summary: Logs support head, tail, and time windows, timestamps, wrapping, pause, and independent viewport following. History has line and byte limits; rotated server output may be unavailable.

rows.capability: Log search/filter, clear, marks, fullscreen, copy/save and bounded buffering
rows.difference: S02/B07 implement literal search, filtering, marks, clear, fullscreen, bounded virtualized history and explicit native/terminal clipboard. O06 #73 routes Save through frozen retained-log review with default redaction, private files, explicit overwrite and local browsing. Log export captures actual producing container/window options and refuses handover sources; no raw-log reveal is offered. Whole-source/platform qualification remains required.
rows.public_summary: Search, filters, marks, clear, fullscreen and explicit redacted copy work on bounded retained output. Version 0.4 adds reviewed log saving and saved-artifact browsing; its frozen source keeps actual container/window provenance and discard notices.
rows.public_title: Log search, marks, copy, save, and history limits

rows.capability: Shell exec with chosen container and configurable shell command
rows.difference: S03/S04 provide captured, chosen-container native kubectl exec with a literal configured shell, private prepared-session connection, guarded launch and retained view on return. #119 adds a clean full-terminal entry and bounded captured-target heading. Actual Linux PTY, installed CLI and disposable-kind evidence is available. Q02 supplies Linux SSH/tmux evidence while macOS qualification remains full platform CI; this does not establish the full capability family. #121 replaces the default native shell route with an embedded Textual PTY/emulator and a persistent target frame; broader terminal compatibility/platform qualification remains separate. Q02 #33 adds actual Linux SSH/tmux/SSH-to-tmux native and embedded shells, private/malformed protocol and buffer-resize recovery, pending-preflight cancellation, child/config cleanup after lost SSH and same-shell tmux reattachment. macOS/platform qualification remains the public-release gate; #123 provides bounded normal-screen history, frozen local review/search and explicit redacted row copy over real child, source/installed PTY and owned-kind shells. Advanced keyboard/mouse protocols remain #124; exact release-candidate platform qualification remains required.
rows.public_summary: A selected container opens an embedded kubectl shell with local history, search, and copy. Write mode, kubectl, and exec permission are required. Advanced terminal protocols are unsupported.

rows.capability: Attach to running containers and bidirectional file transfer
rows.difference: S07 #48 implements captured regular/init/existing-ephemeral attach and reviewed bidirectional file/tree copies. Native attach restores terminal state and preserves process status. Read-only blocks attach/uploads; downloads use explicit destinations, bounded private archives and no-follow extraction. Uploads snapshot local input; cancelled uploads can leave remote partial or completed files without retry. UID/remote filesystem preflight and explicit local replacement retain documented race windows. Final family parity/platform certification remains the audit gate.
rows.public_summary: Attach to supported running containers and review bidirectional file/tree transfers. Uploads and attach require write mode; downloads use explicit local destinations and guarded extraction. Interrupted uploads can leave remote files.

rows.capability: Pod/container/service port forwarding, listing, deletion and bind address
rows.difference: S05 #42 implements owned pod/Service numeric TCP mappings, default loopback and deliberate IPv4/IPv6 bind intent, actual readiness, session listing/stop and resource/context/exit cleanup. S08 #62 extends the next-release source with named ports, presets, annotation opt-in, child transport selection and bounded reconnects; external forwards are not discovered.
rows.public_summary: Manage Pod and Service TCP forwards with explicit bind addresses, readiness, listing, and Stop. Context changes and exit close local sessions. Other terminals' forwards are not discovered.

rows.capability: FastForward annotations, named ports, multiple presets and WebSocket transport
rows.difference: S08 #62 adds literal named/container-qualified mappings, local/context presets and explicit local opt-in for auto annotations. Optional bounded reconnects recheck UID and clean the old process/listener/private file before restarting. Transport modes set kubectl child flags; negotiated protocol and real-provider certification are not claimed.
rows.public_summary: TCP mappings support declared names and container qualification, local presets, explicit annotation shortcuts, transport selection, and up to three reconnect attempts.

rows.capability: Read-only mode, permissions, target validation and dangerous-action gates
rows.difference: F04/F05/M01 enforce captured identity and common read-only policy in CLI, UI, shell/forward and mutation services. Guarded annotation changes have one-use confirmation, atomic UID/version tests and actual patch RBAC evidence. Editing, scale/delete, attach and plugin actions retain their owning tasks. Application read-only is not a security boundary.
rows.public_summary: Read-only policy, selected target identity, permission checks, and one-use confirmations guard changes. Kubernetes RBAC and admission remain authoritative; application read-only mode is not a sandbox.

rows.capability: Edit manifests with external editor and conflict/diff validation
rows.difference: M02/S03 implement selected native editor handoff, deliberately disclosed private full-manifest drafts, bounded YAML/identity checks, separately redacted diff, strict server dry-run and separately confirmed atomic UID/version edits. Cancellation/no-op do not patch; conflicts require a fresh edit. Secret full-manifest disclosure remains C04 #55; public/platform qualification remains pending.
rows.public_summary: Edit supported manifests using a trusted editor after explicit local disclosure, then inspect a redacted diff, validate with a strict server dry-run, and choose Apply separately. This includes deliberate Secret editing.

rows.capability: Scale, restart and rollback workloads; deployment ReplicaSet drill-down
rows.difference: M03 implements reviewed scale/restart/explicit revision rollback and rollout monitoring for documented apps workloads. O03 #70 adds UID-checked owner/ReplicaSet graph navigation in development source. Graph rows are not mutation targets; complete current-head/platform qualification remains separate.
rows.public_summary: Review scale, restart or one explicit available revision rollback for supported controllers. Version 0.4 adds owner/ReplicaSet navigation; open an ordinary resource view before changing a resource.

rows.capability: Delete/force-delete/bulk actions and pod completed/error cleanup
rows.difference: M04 #46 implements explicit single/batch deletion, UID/version preconditions, propagation/grace/count review and independent finalizer/partial/uncertain results. Zero grace stays explicit and never removes finalizers; instantaneous unconfirmed deletion is an intentional safety difference. M08 #63 adds :cleanup, which preselects visible Succeeded/Failed pods that are not terminating into the same reviewed batch (at most 100) and revalidates each target before DELETE.
rows.public_summary: Single/batch deletion reviews identity, grace and propagation, then reports each result separately. It never silently removes finalizers. :cleanup reviews deleting the completed and failed pods in the current view.

rows.capability: Trigger/suspend jobs and CronJobs
rows.difference: M04 #46 implements batch/v1 Job/CronJob suspend/resume and manual CronJob-template Job creation with exact one-use names, independent manual jobs and retained identity/results. Source revalidation and Job creation are separate requests; scheduled concurrency policy does not govern a manual run. Native macOS/full hosted and real-cloud certification remain pending.
rows.public_summary: Review Job/CronJob suspension and resume, or create an independent manual Job from the selected CronJob template. The schedule and concurrency policy do not govern a manual run.

rows.capability: ConfigMap/Secret content, encoded/decoded toggle and environment provenance
rows.difference: ConfigMap/Secret key inspection and editing remain M05. O07 adds current API environment provenance, precedence, bounded field/resource resolution and separate image facts for all container families, with fresh one-use disclosure and metadata-only export. Actual process environment, image ENV, injected Service variables and unsupported runtime sources remain outside observation. Full family parity is not claimed.
rows.public_summary: ConfigMap and Secret keys have explicit reveal/copy and editing. Version 0.4 also traces container environment sources and image facts; values require fresh disclosure.

rows.capability: Local manifest directories, YAML edit, apply/delete and Kustomize
rows.public_summary: Local manifest directories, apply/delete workflows and Kustomize integration are planned.

rows.capability: Helm list/status/notes/values/all-values/manifest/history
rows.difference: M06 development source adds a native Helm release workspace using an optional external CLI, initially pinned to 3.22.1 and 4.3.1 with Secret or ConfigMap storage. Metadata identity, bounded reads, default document redaction and deliberate disclosure are implemented; cumulative phase qualification remains separate. Published 0.4.0 predates this feature.
rows.public_summary: Development source for 0.5 adds Helm release browsing, status, notes, supplied/computed values, manifests and revision history with an optional supported CLI. Published 0.4.0 does not include this workspace.

rows.capability: Helm rollback and uninstall with history options
rows.difference: M06 development source adds reviewed prior-revision rollback with read-only enforcement, fresh actual storage identity and one-use approvals; Helm offers no atomic identity condition and partial/uncertain effects remain explicit. Cumulative phase qualification remains separate. M09 owns the still-planned install, upgrade and uninstall lifecycle.
rows.public_summary: Development source for 0.5 adds reviewed Helm rollback; installation, upgrade and uninstall remain planned. Published 0.4.0 predates Helm management.

rows.capability: Global/per-context themes, transparent colors, light/dark inversion, icon settings
rows.difference: U01 implements explicit built-in/custom theme preview and global/context persistence, runtime inversion with contrast repair, original About and a real optional bounded/cached/offline-safe stable release check. U06 adds terminal-default (transparent) background/surface/panel colors, full API titles and reload of saved palettes. Icon preferences are not implemented; full skin parity is not claimed.
rows.public_summary: Themes support global/context palettes, terminal-default background, preview, explicit save, live reload, and session inversion. Icon preferences are unavailable.

rows.capability: Aliases, hotkeys, columns, alignment/width/order, context/resource view overrides
rows.difference: U02 #57 implements bounded per-owner navigation keys, literal aliases and explicit version-pinned column width/alignment/order/visibility and typed-sort saves. Server schemas invalidate stale layouts. This source checkpoint does not claim broader navigation/filter/jump/plugin parity.
rows.public_summary: Configure additional navigation keys, literal aliases, and global/context resource columns and sort. Inputs keep normal text editing; invalid overrides leave working defaults.

rows.capability: Custom GVR relationship jumps with selectors/templates/namespace
rows.difference: U06 #64 implements named jumps from a source GVR to a target GVR with namespace, label and field templates. Templates only read literal field paths; values are restricted to selector-safe characters and validated as local label/field filters. The target view opens with the filter in the filter box rather than a server-side selector. Reactive reload and per-context jump overrides remain planned. O03 #70 adds native discovered custom-owner navigation within the same history model. It does not recursively infer arbitrary CR reference fields; full current-head acceptance remains pending.
rows.public_summary: Define preference-file jumps and use :jump to open related views with a local filter. Version 0.4 adds native discovered-owner graphs using the same history; arbitrary custom-resource reference discovery is unavailable.

rows.capability: Reactive settings reload, paths, feature gates, connection/log/metric thresholds
rows.difference: All schema fields are enumerated in the source inventory; compatible semantics do not imply identical config files. U06 reloads a validated preference file while the app runs, keeps the last valid file and adds per-context read-only/refresh settings. Feature gates and connection/log/metric thresholds remain F03/O01. O01 #68 owns fixed 15-second serialized metrics batches and 60-second current-sample expiry; configurable metric/color thresholds are not implemented.
rows.public_summary: Valid saved preferences reload while the application runs; an invalid file leaves the last working settings active. Contexts can add read-only mode or a refresh interval. Connection/log/metric threshold controls are unavailable.

rows.capability: Plugin search paths, scopes, shortcut overrides, confirmation and dangerous flag
rows.difference: U03/U04 implement the independent explicit schema and owned local execution.
